{"script":"set -euo pipefail
rm -rf temp_npm_check
mkdir -p temp_npm_check
# 2. Capture PATH
printf '%s' "$PATH" > temp_npm_check/path_snapshot.txt
# 3. Enumerate entries in common dirs
dirs=(/usr/bin /usr/local/bin /opt /snap/bin /bin /sbin /usr/sbin /usr/local/sbin /home/*/.local/bin)
: > temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt
for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    echo "--- $d ---" >> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt
    ls -la "$d" >> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
done
# Also list PATH dirs individually
IFS=':' read -r -a pathdirs <<< "$PATH"
for pd in "${pathdirs[@]}"; do
  if [ -d "$pd" ]; then
    echo "--- $pd (from PATH) ---" >> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt
    ls -la "$pd" >> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
done
# 4. Extract entries named 'npm' and record paths + metadata
: > temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt
# Search in the enumerated dirs
search_dirs=(/usr/bin /usr/local/bin /opt /snap/bin /bin /sbin /usr/sbin /usr/local/sbin)
for sd in "${search_dirs[@]}"; do
  if [ -d "$sd" ]; then
    find "$sd" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'npm' -print0 2>/dev/null | \
      while IFS= read -r -d '' fp; do
        stat -c '%n|%F|%A|%U:%G|%s|%y' "$fp" >> temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt || true
      done
  fi
done
# Also check PATH dirs for 'npm'
for pd in "${pathdirs[@]}"; do
  if [ -f "$pd/npm" ]; then
    stat -c '%n|%F|%A|%U:%G|%s|%y' "$pd/npm" >> temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt || true
  fi
done
# Deduplicate candidates
if [ -f temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt ]; then
  sort -u temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt -o temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt || true
fi
# 5. For each candidate path, attempt to read header/version text
: > temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log
if [ -s temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    path_part=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -d'|' -f1)
    echo "=== $path_part ===" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log
    if [ -x "$path_part" ]; then
      # Try --version
      ("$path_part" --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^/EXEC: /') >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log || true
      file "$path_part" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>&1 || true
      strings -n 5 "$path_part" 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log || true
    else
      file "$path_part" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>&1 || true
      head -n 20 "$path_part" 2>/dev/null >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log || true
    fi
  done < temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt
fi
# 6. Verify created files are present and readable
expected=(temp_npm_check/path_snapshot.txt temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log)
: > temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
all_ok=1
for f in "${expected[@]}"; do
  if [ -f "$f" ] && [ -r "$f" ]; then
    echo "$f: present, readable" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
  else
    echo "$f: MISSING or not readable" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
    all_ok=0
  fi
done
# Also reconcile: if npm_candidates present but empty, note it
if [ -f temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt ]; then
  if [ ! -s temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt ]; then
    echo "npm_candidates.txt: no candidates found" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
  else
    echo "npm_candidates.txt: candidates listed" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
  fi
fi
# 7. Prepare to determine installation status: analyze summary and probe log
# Determine installed: prefer command -v npm
installed=0
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ver=$(npm --version 2>/dev/null || true)
  if printf '%s' "$ver" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'; then
    installed=1
  fi
fi
# If not found by command, check candidates by trying each executable candidate
if [ "$installed" -eq 0 ] && [ -f temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt ] && [ -s temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    path_part=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -d'|' -f1)
    if [ -x "$path_part" ]; then
      ver=$("$path_part" --version 2>/dev/null || true)
      if printf '%s' "$ver" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'; then
        installed=1
        break
      fi
    fi
  done < temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt
fi
# Final concise output: only 'yes' or 'no'
if [ "$installed" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
